verdict.rationale: Oracle's own docs describe an OCI Terraform provider that connects Terraform to the OCI services you want to manage, and Resource Manager can import existing Terraform state, so a first-party provider clearly exists. However, nothing in the pack shows its release cadence, which core services it covers, or OpenTofu compatibility. Missing for 10: evidence of active release cadence, documented coverage of core services (compute, networking, storage, DB), OpenTofu support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the official Terraform/OpenTofu provider is real — vendor-maintained, actively released, covering the core services I run

citations.quote: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Terraform provider is a component that connects Terraform to the OCI services that you want to manage.
To migrate an existing Terraform state file to Resource Manager, use an import job
